text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's time for training and Gold Ship is
nowhere to
be found. I search for her
around the academy
and come across a
strange scene.

text_block_list.name: Tree Fairy (?)
text_block_list.text:
Yup, there you go! ☆ Make sure to
swing your
arms if you want to get
faster! ☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch for the advice, Miss
Fairy! I'll try
my very best!

text_block_list.name: Tree Fairy (?)
text_block_list.text:
Yup! All you can do is try, try, and try
again! I'm
rooting for you! Teehee! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship suddenly jumps down from a
tree and
lands before me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What're you doing all the way out here?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Me? I'm being a fairy. What about you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, shoot! Today's a training day, isn't
it? Ahaha,
I totally forgot!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Big soz, Trainer! Think you can let me
slide just
this once?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I let her off easy but warn her not to let
it happen
again.
